decisions.thought: Rotom-Wash is the best lead: Choice Scarf gives useful speed control and Hydro Pump pressures opposing Garchomp and Gholdengo. Primarina covers the dragons, while our Garchomp adds a strong answer to Kingambit and opposing Rotom-Wash.

Rotom-Wash moves first and Kingambit is likely a physical attacker, so Will-O-Wisp can sharply limit its damage for the rest of the battle. It’s the best play unless it misses or Kingambit has a burn-curing item.

Will-o-wisp would be effective for burning, but Kingambit's Defiant ability makes that irrelevant for status. If it teras, that complicates things. I think I’ll go with the Will-o-Wisp for now, as it reduces attack and provides consistent chip damage. That feels like the safer bet!
